y-m-34-05.topic: Qaybinta polynomial: shuruudda qaybta iyo hadhaagga xitaa marka A=BQ+R run yahay
y-m-34-05.goal: Naftaada ku xaqiiji in ay jiraan dhowr (Q,R) oo A=B·Q+R run yahay, fahan in shuruud ku saabsan darajada hadhaagga loo baahan yahay si loo aqbalo sida qaybta iyo hadhaagga, oo sii wad qaybinta adigoo hagaajinaya jawaab aan shuruudda ku habboonayn.
y-m-34-05.material:
Qaybi A(x)=x³+2x²+3x+4 B(x)=x²+1. Saddex arday ayaa yidhaahdeen kuwa soo socda, saddexduba waxay xaqiijiyeen in 'A=B·Q+R run yahay'. 
   Jimin: qaybta Q=x+2, hadhaagga R=2x+2 
   Harin: qaybta Q=x+1, hadhaagga R=x²+2x+3 
   Doyun: qaybta Q=x, hadhaagga R=2x²+2x+4

y-m-34-09.s.s1.hint.0: Adigu dooro laba tibaax jajab-saddexaad, xisaabi wadarta, oo qor darajadeeda, oo tan dhowr jeer samee. Sidoo kale beddel qiimaha ay wadarta labada isku-dhufasho hoggaamiye qaadato.
y-m-34-09.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir in ay jiraan kiisas darajadu wadarta ku sare marto, iyo waxa darajada ugu sarreysa aysan marnaba ka gudbi karin.
y-m-34-09.s.s1.r.a: Wadarta, darajooyinku isku ma darmaan. Darajooyinka isku darmaan waa wax ka dhaca wax-ku-dhufasho.
y-m-34-09.s.s1.r.b: Haddii ereyada hoggaamiyuhu is-darto oo baaba'o oo erey x² uu hadho, waa tibaax jajab-labaad.
y-m-34-09.s.s1.r.c: Haddii ereyada x³, x², iyo x dhammaantood baaba'aan oo joogtada oo keliya ay hadho, waa daraje 0.
y-m-34-09.s.s1.r.d: Wadarta, erey ka sarreeya darajada ugu sarreysa ee labada tibaax si cusub ugama soo muuqan karo.
y-m-34-09.s.s1.r.e: Haddii wadarta isku-dhufashooyinka hoggaamiyuhu aysan ahayn 0, waa tibaax jajab-saddexaad.
y-m-34-09.s.s1.r.f: Haddii ereyada x³ iyo x² baaba'aan oo erey x uu hadho, waa tibaax toosan.
y-m-34-09.s.s1.explain: Ereyga hoggaamiyaha wadartu waa x³ ama ka hooseeya. Haddii wadarta isku-dhufashooyinka x³ aysan ahayn 0, darajadu waa 3; haddii wadartaasi tahay 0 oo erey x² uu hadho, darajadu waa 2; haddii erey x uu hadho, 1; haddii joogtada oo keliya ay hadho, 0 (tusaale ahaan, wadarta x³+1 iyo -x³ waa 1). Daraje 4 ama 6 ma dhici karto.
y-m-34-09.s.s2.prompt: A(x)=2x³-x²+4x+1. Samee saddex tibaax jajab-saddexaad oo kala duwan B(x)=px³+qx²+rx+s (p, q, r, s waa tirooyin dhan) si A+B ay si sax ah u noqoto tibaax toosan.
y-m-34-09.s.s2.hint.0: Qor isku-dhufasho kasta ee A+B sida (isku-dhufashada A)+(isku-dhufashada B).
y-m-34-09.s.s2.hint.1: Isku-dhufashooyinka ereyada daraja 3 iyo daraja 2 waa inay noqdaan 0, isku-dhufashada ereyga daraja 1-na waa inaanay noqon 0. Qor hal shuruudood isku-dhufasho kasta oo u beddel isleegyo p, q, r, iyo s ku jira.

y-m-34-09.s.s2.fail.c2: B waa inuu noqdaa tibaax jajab-saddexaad. Isku-dhufashada x³ waa inaanay noqon 0.

y-m-34-09.s.s3.prompt: Marka A iyo B labaduba yihiin tibaax jajab-saddexaad, darajada A·B had iyo jeer waa 6. Sharax sababta darajada wax-ku-dhufashadu hoos ugu dhicin, si ka duwan wadarta A+B.
y-m-34-09.s.s3.hint.0: Qor A=ax³+... iyo B=bx³+..., oo qor sida erayga darajada ugu sarreysa ee A·B loo sameeyo.

y-m-34-09.s.s3.model.1: Wax-ku-dhufasho, ereyga x⁶ waxaa sameeya hal shay oo keliya, wax-ku-dhufashada ereyada hoggaamiyaha, sidaas darteed erey kale ma tirtiri karo. y-m-34-01.title: Haddii laba qiime oo keliya la og yahay, ma hadhaagu waa la go'aamiyaa?
y-m-34-01.topic: Doorarka hadhaagga iyo qaybta: marka lagu qaybiyo odhaah labajibbaar ah, ma hadhaagu waa la go'aamiyaa qiimayaasha la yaqaan oo keliya?
y-m-34-01.goal: Go'aami haddii hadhaagga polynomial oo qaar ka mid ah qiimayaasha oo keliya la yaqaan uu sida hal u go'aansan yahay adigoo barbar dhigaya tirada aan la aqoon iyo tirada shuruudaha la yaqaan, oo samee polynomials kala duwan oo buuxiya isla shuruudaha si aad u kala saarto doorarka qaybta iyo hadhaagga.
y-m-34-01.material:
Polynomial f(x) leh isku-dhufashooyin dhab ah, laba arrimood oo soo socda ayaa la og yahay oo keliya. 
   f(1)=3, f(2)=5 
 (Darajada f(x) iyo isku-dhufashooyinka hadhaagga lama oga.) Hadda waxaad rabtaa inaad ogaato hadhaagga marka f(x) lagu qaybiyo (x-1)(x-2).

y-m-34-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qor natiijada qaybinta qaabka f(x)=(qaybiye)×(qayb)+(hadhaag), oo qor xaddidaadda hadhaagga leeyahay.

y-m-34-01.s.s1.r.d: 3 iyo 5 waa qiimayaasha x=1 iyo x=2. Hadhaagu waa odhaah x ah, sidaas darteed qiimayaashan laftoodu ma aha hadhaagga.
